events.title: My Desktop Dwarf is in Steam Next Fest: keep Brokk on your taskbar
events.summary: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge is part of Steam Next Fest until October 26, and the free demo is on Steam. Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. Every key you press is one swing of his hammer. When you pause he wipes his brow and takes a sip, and when you go for a coffee he naps on his stool. events.title: Demo 0.4.7: Brokk keeps hammering while you play
events.summary: Thank you for being here and for your reports in the Bug Reporting thread. This update is built on them. Mouse clicks count again while a game is fullscreen, so Brokk keeps forging whether you play with the keyboard or the mouse. The forge now has a taskbar button and an Alt+Tab entry. Pick it there to bring the forge up over your game, then click back into the game and it steps aside again. Need the forge out of the way? events.title: Demo 0.4.6: Brokk makes room for fullscreen Steam games and apps
events.summary: Thank you for being here and for your reports in the Bug Reporting thread. This small update fixes both problems described there. The forge now hides while a game or video is fullscreen on its monitor. Games stay in fullscreen and the mouse no longer escapes to a second monitor. Prefer to see it over the game? events.title: The demo is available now!
events.summary: Hi everyone, The free demo of My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge is now available on Steam! I'm really excited to be writing that sentence. I'm one man developer and I'm really happy to share this little game with you. The idea I wanted to bring to life was simple: a small companion to keep you company during an ordinary day at your keyboard.
